evals.prompt: Our Argo CD app 'checkout' is permanently OutOfSync. The diff shows spec.replicas is 3 in Git but 7 live, and an HPA exists. What's going on and what do we change? (Scenario: answer with the reasoning and commands, do not run anything.)
expectations: Identifies the HPA as owner of replicas so Argo sees drift
Recommends removing replicas from the manifest or a narrow ignoreDifferences on /spec/replicas
Mentions RespectIgnoreDifferences or that sync must not overwrite the ignored field
Does not recommend ignoring the whole Deployment or disabling sync as the fix

evals.prompt: I removed the old 'postgres' StatefulSet manifest from our Git repo to tidy up. Prod Argo CD has automated sync with prune on. Anything I should worry about before merging?
expectations: Says prune will delete the live StatefulSet
Warns about PVCs / data loss and recommends Prune=false protection or a backup first
Suggests previewing the diff or rendering before merge
Recommends review and approval for the deletion in prod

evals.prompt: Prod is down because of a bad config value and the Flux Kustomization will revert any kubectl fix within 5 minutes. What's the correct emergency procedure?
expectations: Says to suspend the Flux Kustomization (or disable auto-sync) before the manual fix
Says to commit the same fix to Git
Says to resume reconciliation afterwards
Prefers git revert as the cleanest fix when possible
Does not recommend leaving it suspended or only patching live

evals.prompt: We committed a Kubernetes Secret manifest with base64 values to our GitOps repo last month. A teammate says base64 is fine since the repo is private. Thoughts and next steps?
expectations: Says base64 is encoding, not encryption
Says to rotate the secret since it is in Git history
Recommends SOPS, Sealed Secrets or External Secrets Operator
Notes that rewriting history alone does not un-leak the secret

evals.prompt: Flux shows our 'apps' Kustomization as 'dependency infra is not ready' and nothing has been deployed for an hour. How do we debug it?
expectations: Says to inspect the dependsOn target (infra) and fix it first
Uses flux get kustomizations / describe / events or logs to find the reason
Mentions checking the source (GitRepository) and suspend state
Does not recommend removing dependsOn as the first step

evals.prompt: We deployed a bad release with Argo CD. What's the right way to roll back in a GitOps setup, and what are the catches with 'argocd app rollback'?
expectations: Recommends git revert so Git stays the source of truth
Says argocd app rollback requires auto-sync to be disabled
Says rollback via the CLI leaves Git out of sync with the cluster / will be reverted when auto-sync resumes

evals.prompt: Review this GitOps repo for risks before we onboard production. (Scenario: the repo is at evals/fixtures/repo; its relevant contents: an Argo Application using project default with repoURL containing user:PLACEHOLDER@ credentials, prune+selfHeal and Replace=true; an ingress-nginx chart with targetRevision '*'; a Deployment using image ghcr.io/acme/api:latest and a busybox sidecar with no tag; a plaintext Secret with stringData password; kustomization with commonLabels and an unpinned remote base github.com/acme/shared-base; a Flux HelmRelease with version '>=18.0.0'; a Flux Kustomization with prune and force: true.)
expectations: Flags the plaintext Secret and says to rotate it
Flags credentials embedded in the repoURL
Flags the :latest / untagged images
Flags unpinned chart versions (* and >=)
Flags the default AppProject
Flags Replace=true and force: true as downtime risks
Flags commonLabels changing immutable selectors
Flags the remote base without a pinned ref

evals.prompt: How should we promote a release from staging to prod in a GitOps setup? We currently have a long-lived 'prod' branch and a 'staging' branch.
expectations: Recommends directories/overlays per environment instead of long-lived environment branches
Says to promote the same immutable artifact (tag or digest), not rebuild
Says prod change goes through a reviewed PR
Warns against mutable tags like latest
